final_review.suggestions: 1. Fix handle_ack: after removing the acknowledged op from pending_ops, apply the op (using op_id or the server’s transformed operation) to synced_doc, e.g., op = client_op from pending; self.synced_doc = ot.apply_op(self.synced_doc, op). 2. In server_room.remove_client, after unlocking, if _grant_next_lock returns a status dict, broadcast it to all clients and send a lock_grant to the new holder. 3. Implement Ctrl+Left/Right by handling low-level key codes (e.g., parse escape sequences for word-left and word-right) or revert to standard Shift+Left/Right if that maps. 4. Add Shift+Enter handling in modal search to call _cycle_search(forward=False). 5. Remove dead code in _render_highlighted_line and unused imports across files. 6. Optionally improve word jumping to consider non-alphanumeric boundaries, but not strictly required.
